posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
Christopher:

Nah, I'm going to release a complicated a ruling that'll mess everything up.

Well we need one, the reworking of card play order pretty much crushed all of our fun with arguing rules and interpretting syntax to have all kinds of meaning.

 

I propose the following changes:  

All damage must be dealt in alphabetical order.

Every turn is now considered the Environment turn.

Text spelled "would be dealt" is now changed to "Would like to be Dealt"

If health order changes that would change the target of an attack happens in the middle of applying the whole attack, reapply the entire attack immediately.

On Raptor Bot the word Melee is replaced by Fluffy.
